ABOUT OUR ACADEMY

MORE THAN A SPORT.
A WAY TO GROW.

Dynamic Karate & Dance Academy is dedicated to developing physical fitness, self-defence skills, discipline, confidence, and sports excellence among children, teenagers, and adults.

With years of experience in martial arts, school sports, physical education, and fitness training, we provide professional coaching through qualified and certified trainers.

Our mission is not just to train athletes but to build confident, disciplined, healthy, and successful individuals.

FOUNDER & HEAD COACH

MD BHURAN

A passionate martial artist, professional Karate Coach, Physical Education & Sports Trainer, and Certified Fitness Trainer with extensive experience in martial arts and school sports.

MARTIAL ARTS JOURNEY & ACHIEVEMENTS

Taekwondo Journey

  • Started Taekwondo training in 2016 at Eklavya Stadium, Agra.
  • Achieved Black Belt in Taekwondo in 2018.

Karate Journey – Japanese Shotokan Karate

  • 19 February 2018 – Yellow Belt
  • 7 June 2018 – Orange Belt
  • 2 December 2018 – Green Belt
  • February 2019 – Brown Belt
  • 18 November 2019 – 1st Dan Black Belt
  • 8 August 2023 – 2nd Dan Black Belt
  • 12 September 2025 – 3rd Dan Black Belt

Black Belt certifications and Dan promotions in Japanese Shotokan Karate Do Federation India.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

  • Working in school sports, physical education, and fitness training since 2018.
  • Experience working with more than 15 schools.
  • Successfully trained over 20,000 students.
  • Guided numerous students towards District, State, and National-level competitions.
  • Several students have achieved selections in SAI (Sports Authority of India).
  • Proud to have trained SGFI Gold Medalists.

OUR PROFESSIONAL TEAM

We have a team of certified and experienced trainers, including both male and female coaches, to provide professional training in a safe, supportive, and motivating environment.
